purpose: Preserve implementation-ready acceptance requirements that make N0TE trustworthy across ordinary-user operation, restarts, crashes, upgrades, provider loss, machine changes, context compression and future agent/controller runs. These constraints stack onto accepted product scope; they do not replace the SCOPE_LEDGER, create a parallel roadmap, or self-select construction work.
selection_policy: DOES_NOT_SELF_SELECT; reconcile against completion graph and promote only through a current baseline-bound receipt

authority_posture.rule: Captured items are durable acceptance candidates/obligations for reconciliation. Capture alone does not assert that an item is implemented, complete, selected, or constitutionally accepted unless separately established by current authority or explicit user decision.

acceptance_items.name: Normal-user operation without elevation
acceptance_items.requirement: Core N0TE operation on supported Windows, macOS and Linux must work under a normal non-admin account without administrator/root elevation, Developer Mode, special privilege grants, security-policy changes or equivalent trust-breaking setup. Privilege-requiring integrations, if ever justified, must be optional and capability-isolated.

acceptance_items.name: Cold-start reconstruction
acceptance_items.requirement: A fresh local process reconstructs useful current Artist/Song/workspace/execution state from durable sources without previous RAM, warm caches or prior conversation context.

acceptance_items.name: Fresh-agent reconstruction
acceptance_items.requirement: A fresh agent/controller reconstructs lifecycle, authority, incidents, supervision, context policy and next admissible action from durable/live authority without normal dependence on chat archaeology.

acceptance_items.name: Offline core continuity
acceptance_items.requirement: Loss of cloud AI, GitHub, Drive, internet, telemetry or optional providers must not erase local creative history or prevent supported local core work.

acceptance_items.name: Provider-loss graceful degradation
acceptance_items.requirement: Provider unavailability changes capability availability, not the identity or truth of the underlying user goal; unrelated functionality remains usable.

acceptance_items.name: Crash consistency
acceptance_items.requirement: Power loss, process termination or interrupted writes must not silently create half-applied canonical state; recovery state remains explicit and testable.

acceptance_items.name: Corruption visibility
acceptance_items.requirement: Unreadable or contradictory durable state fails visibly and safely rather than being guessed, silently repaired or interpreted as plausible truth.

acceptance_items.name: Upgrade and migration safety
acceptance_items.requirement: Updates preserve canonical identity/history, validate migrations, retain rollback evidence and never silently reinterpret or strand Artist/Song data.

acceptance_items.name: Rollback and recovery
acceptance_items.requirement: Failed updates or damaged live state restore only from validated known-good evidence or report recovery-required explicitly; no silent best-effort mutation of valuable data.

acceptance_items.name: Uninstall retention separation
acceptance_items.requirement: Removing the application and deleting the user's creative/canonical history are separate, explicit decisions.

acceptance_items.name: Stable identity independent of path
acceptance_items.requirement: Canonical identity must not depend solely on absolute path, drive letter, username, process id, window title, temporary provider id or other volatile locator.

acceptance_items.name: Filesystem portability
acceptance_items.requirement: Supported flows deliberately handle spaces, Unicode, long names, case differences, removable/network locations and platform-specific link/file-lock semantics without requiring elevated privileges.

acceptance_items.name: Time and locale portability
acceptance_items.requirement: Timezone/DST changes, locale formatting and system-clock irregularities do not corrupt chronology, scheduling, ordering or durable identity.

acceptance_items.name: Architecture portability
acceptance_items.requirement: Supported CPU architecture differences are explicit capability/support states, never silent feature disappearance.

acceptance_items.name: Capability detection
acceptance_items.requirement: N0TE observes required DAW/plugin/hardware/OS/provider capabilities and does not infer availability solely from platform, installation or stale memory.

acceptance_items.name: Graceful degradation
acceptance_items.requirement: Missing optional capability disables only dependent behavior and leaves unrelated core journeys operational.

acceptance_items.name: Idempotent retry
acceptance_items.requirement: Restarting or retrying an unchanged operation cannot duplicate durable mutations, uploads, jobs, migrations, messages, releases or equivalent effects.

acceptance_items.name: At-most-once external consequence
acceptance_items.requirement: Consequential send/publish/release/delete/payment-like actions use stable attempt/correlation identity and reconcile evidence before retrying an unknown outcome.

acceptance_items.name: Concurrent-instance safety
acceptance_items.requirement: Multiple processes/controllers cannot simultaneously believe they own the same exclusive mutation lease; stale owners cannot release or destroy newer ownership.

acceptance_items.name: Stale-observation rejection
acceptance_items.requirement: Prior-run evidence remains historical; current action depends on fresh evidence where state can change, including repository head, DAW, filesystem, provider, credentials and capability state.

acceptance_items.name: Contradiction visibility
acceptance_items.requirement: Conflicting durable claims remain attributable and unresolved until reconciled; they are never averaged into invented certainty.

acceptance_items.name: Provenance traceability
acceptance_items.requirement: Consequential remembered or inferred facts retain enough source/provenance to answer why N0TE believes them and whether they are current.

acceptance_items.name: Memory demotion without deletion
acceptance_items.requirement: Stale/superseded material can leave active retrieval while canonical/audit history remains available for reconstruction and provenance.

acceptance_items.name: User correction supersession
acceptance_items.requirement: Explicit corrections supersede or reconcile prior claims durably with provenance instead of merely influencing the current response.

acceptance_items.name: Secrets boundary
acceptance_items.requirement: Credentials, tokens and secrets do not drift into Song memory, generic context projections, logs, telemetry, source control or portable recovery/export artifacts.

acceptance_items.name: Local privacy boundary
acceptance_items.requirement: Local/private state remains local by default; crossing to cloud/provider surfaces requires a defined purpose, authority and bounded payload.

acceptance_items.name: User data export and escape hatch
acceptance_items.requirement: Canonical user-created history remains inspectable/exportable/portable so N0TE never becomes the only practical way to access the user's own work.

future_run_contract.principle: Future runs inherit durable state and obligations, not automatic momentum. WAITING, BLOCKED and STABLE remain legitimate states.
